Problems We Treat

Book a Consult
(780) 421-4441

If something feels wrong, trust that feeling.

Sensitivity, worn teeth, gum concerns, missing teeth, or changes you’ve noticed over time can affect your comfort and confidence. The good news is that many concerns have solutions that are more straightforward and comfortable than people expect.

At Mayra Dental Clinic, we take a specialist-led approach to diagnosing and treating dental concerns with precision and care. You’ll always know what we’re seeing, what your options are, and what we recommend for your long-term health and comfort.

Book a Consult

Dental concerns we help with

Missing teeth can affect the way you chew, speak, and smile. We offer dental implants, bridges, and dentures designed for comfort, stability, and natural aesthetics.
Missing Teeth

Missing teeth can affect the way you chew, speak, and smile. We offer dental implants, bridges, and dentures designed for comfort, stability, and natural aesthetics.

Dental implant planning and restorations
If you’re exploring implants, we help you understand your options and what’s possible. Our implant restorations are designed to look natural and feel secure, with careful planning every step of the way.
Bone support for future restorations
If bone support is needed before implants, bone grafting can help create a strong foundation. We’ll explain what that means for you and whether it’s recommended.
Worn or weakened teeth
Grinding, erosion, and aging dental work can change your bite and wear down tooth structure. We restore strength and function with crowns, bridges, and restorative solutions designed to protect your smile.
Chipped, cracked, or uneven teeth
Even small chips or changes in shape can affect your comfort and confidence. We restore teeth with bonding, veneers, or crowns, depending on what best supports your smile.
Cavities and tooth decay
Cavities are common and treatable. We use durable, natural-looking fillings and crowns to restore tooth structure and help protect long-term oral health.
Gum disease and bleeding gums
If your gums bleed, feel tender, or appear swollen, periodontal therapy can help. Our goal is to support healthier gums and protect the foundation of your smile.
Gum recession and tissue concerns
Gum recession can lead to sensitivity and changes in how your smile looks. Gum grafting may help restore and protect gum tissue in a comfortable, thoughtful way.
Discoloration or aesthetic concerns
If you want a brighter, more refined smile, we offer whitening, veneers, bonding, and cosmetic restorations that enhance your look while keeping results natural.
Jaw tension and TMJ discomfort
Jaw soreness, tightness, or clenching can affect your daily comfort. We offer TMJ treatment, bite support, and custom guards to reduce strain and protect your teeth
Teeth that need removal
Sometimes removing a tooth is the best step for comfort and long-term health. If extraction is recommended, we’ll focus on gentle care and clear next-step options for replacement.
Comprehensive smile reconstruction
If multiple concerns are happening at once, we can create a full-mouth reconstruction plan that restores balance, comfort, and confidence with a carefully sequenced approach.

A calm, supportive experience from start to finish.

We understand that dental visits can feel stressful, especially if you’ve had a difficult experience in the past. Our team is here to make things feel easier, with a welcoming environment, a clear step-by-step process, and sedation options available if you need extra support.
We take our time, answer your questions, and create a plan that fits your goals.

Your Questions,

Answered

What if I’m not sure what treatment I need?
That’s completely normal. Many patients come to us knowing something feels off, but not knowing the right solution. We’ll evaluate your smile, explain what we see, and guide you through your best options.
Do I need a referral to book an appointment?
No referral is needed. You can schedule directly with our team at any time.
Do you offer dental implants and full-mouth reconstruction?

Yes. Dental implants and full-mouth reconstruction are two of our core specialties. Every plan is customized to support long-term comfort, function, and natural aesthetics.

Do you offer sedation dentistry for anxious patients?
Yes. We offer sedation options to help patients feel calm and comfortable throughout treatment. If you feel nervous, just let us know and we’ll take care of the rest.
What makes Mayra different from a general dental office?
Mayra is a multi-specialty practice led by a prosthodontist and supported by periodontal expertise. We focus on advanced planning, high-end restorative care, and results designed to last.
Do you offer financing?
Yes. We offer financing options including 0% financing for up to 24 months, plus longer-term monthly payment plans through Beautifi.
